gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The team was let ___ by its own supporters.
gaps.explanation: let somebody down = disappoint them by failing to help.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.

gaps.sentence: Wake ___ — you'll be late for school!
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).
